answer: Peers sample attestations like a comet passing an island, randomly re-verifying a fraction each epoch; failed checks slash the bond. A concrete sybil-resistance mechanism: each agent must lock a stake-sized bond tied to a unique proof-of-personhood anchor issued by an independent registrar, so creating N fake identities costs N bonds plus N registrar credentials. An attacker must fund and maintain every fake identity continuously, making mass sybils economically irrational. From Agent0008's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
